s: BakAraH । sa ca vyaYjanacaturviMSatitamaH pavargIyacaturTo varRaH । asyoccAraRasTAnaM ozWaH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (taTA ca sidDAntakOmudyAm । upUpaDmAnIyAnAmozWO ॥”) tasya svarUpAdi yaTA, -- “BakAraM SfRu cArvvaNgi ! svayaM paramakuRqalI । mahAmokzapradaM varRaM taruRAdityasaMpraBam ॥ paYcaprARamayaM varRaM paYcadevamayaM sadA .” iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ (vaNgAkzarAkftO) tasya liKanakramo yaTA, -- “UrdDADaHkramato reKA vAme vakrA tu kuRqalI । punaScADogatA sEva ata UrdDagatA punaH ॥ brahmA SamBuSca vizRuYca kramatastAsu tizWati ॥” asya leKanaprakArAntaraM yaTA, -- “kiYcidAkuYcitA reKA vAmaddakziRato gatA । tato vakrA vAmagatA tAsu vARyAdayaH kramAt ॥ fjumAtrA maDyagatA koRAddakzagatA punaH । mahASaktisvarUpA sA DyAnamasya pracakzate ॥” tadyaTA, -- “taqitpraBAM mahAdevIM nAgakaNkaRaSoBitAm ॥ zaqBujAM varadAM BImAM raktapaNkajalocanAm ॥ raktavastraparIDAnAM raktapuzpopaSoBitAm । caturvargapradAM debIM sADakABIzwasidDidAm ॥ evaM DyAtvA brahmarUpAM tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” tatpraRAmamantro yaTA, -- “triSaktisahitaM varRaM tribindusahitaM priye ! । AtmAditattvasaMyuktaM BakAraM praRamAmyaham ॥” iti varRodDAratantram ॥ tasya nAsAni yaTA, -- “BaH klinnA Bramaro BImo viSvamUrttirniSABavam । dbiraRqo BUzaRo mUlaM yajYasUtrasya vAcakaH ॥ nakzatraM BramaRA dIptirvayo BUmiH payo naBaH । nABirBadraM mahAbAhurviSvamUrttirvitARqakaH ॥ prARAtmA tApinI vajrA viSvarUpI ca candrikA । BImasenaH suDAsenaH suKo mAyApuraM haraH ॥” iti nAnAtantraSAstram ॥

klI, (BAtIti । BA dIptO + bAhulakAt qaH .) nakzatram । ityamaraH । 1 । 3 । 21 ॥ (yaTA, sUryyasidDAnte । 1 । 26 । “prAggatitvamatastezAM BagaREH pratyahaM gatiH । pariRAhavaSAdBinnA tadvaSAd BAni BuYjate ॥”) grahaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ rASiH । yaTA, -- “rASinAmAni ca kzetraM BamfkzaM gfhanAma ca ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥
puM, (BAtIti । BA dIptO + bAhulAd qaH .) SukrAcAryyaH । iti medinI । Be, 1 ॥ BramaraH । ityekAkzarakozaH । BrAntiH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: BakAraH pavargIyaScaturTovarRo vyaYjanavarRaBedaH । tasyoccAraRasTAnamOzWO । asyoccAraRe AByantaraprayatnaH ozWAByAM saha jihvAgrasya sparSaH atastasya sparSavarRatA । bAhyaprayatnASca saMvAranAdaGozAH mahAprARaSca । tasya DyeyarUpaM yaTA “BakAraM SfRu cArvaNgi! svayaMparamakuRqalI । mahAmokzapradaM varRaM taruRAdityasaMpraBam । paYcaprARamayaM varRaM paYcadevamayaM sadA” kAmaDenutantram । asya aDizWAtfdevatADyAnaM yaTA “taqitpraBAM mahAdevIM nAgakaNkaRaSoBitAm । zaqBujAM varadAM BImAM raktapaNkajalocanAm । raktavastraparIDAnAM raktapuzpopaSoBitAm । caturvargapradAM devIM sADakABIzwasidDidAm । evaM DyAtvA brahmarUpAM tanmantraM daSaDA japet” । asya vAcakaSabdAH yaTA “BaH klinnA Bramaro BImo viSvamUrttirniSABavam । dviraRqo BUzaRomUlaM yajYasUtrapravAcakaH । nakzatraM BramaRA dIprirvayoBUmiH payo naBaH । nABirBadaM mahAbAhurviSvamUrttirvitARqavaH । prARAtmA tApinI vajrA viSvarUpI ca candrikA । BImasenaH suDAsenaH suKI mayApuraM haraH” । varRABiDAnam । mAtfkAnyAse'sya nABO nyAsyatA kAvyAdAvasya prayoge “suKaBayamaraRakleSaduHKaM pavargaH” vf॰ wI॰ ukteH kleSaH Palam ।

na॰ BAti BA--ka । 1 nakzatre amaraH । 2 grahe SabdaratnA॰ । 3 rASO jyo॰ ta॰ । 4 SukrAcAryye pu॰ medi॰ । tezAM dIptimattvAt taTAttvam । 5 BUDare ekAkzarakozaH । 6 BrAntO pu॰ SabdaratnA॰ । vf॰ ra॰ ukte 7 Adiguruke antyalaGudvaye varRatraye । tasya kAvyAdO prayoge PalaM yaSaH devatAcandraH yaToktaM vf॰ ra॰ wIkAyAm “BaScandro yaSaH ujjvalam” ।
m: 2. भ (in gram.) N. of the weakest base of nouns (as opp. to पद and अङ्ग, q.v.) i.e. of the base before the vowel terminations except in strong cases, before feminine suffixes, and before Taddhitas beginning with vowels or य्, Pāṇ. i, 4, 18 &c.
4. भ m. (√ 1. भा) N. of the planet Venus or its regent, (= शुक्र), L.
भ n. a star, planet, asterism, lunar a˚ or mansion (and so also the number 27; cf. नक्षत्र), sign of the zodiac, GṛS.; Sūryas.; Var.; Śatr. &c.
5. भ m. (prob. onomat.) a bee, L.
a: भः — 1 N. of the planet Venus. --2 Error, delusion, mere semblance. --3 An epithet of Śukra. --4 N. given to the base of nouns before the vowel terminations beginning with accusative plural; cf. अंग and पद. --भं 1 A star. --2 A lunar mansion or asterism. --3 A planet. --4 A sign of the zodiac. --5 The number twenty-seven. --6 A bee --Comp. --ईनः, --ईशः the sun. --कक्षा the path of the asterisms. --गणः, वर्गः {1} the group of stars or asterisms. {2} the zodiac. {3} revolution of the planets in the zodiac. --गोलः the starry sphere. --चक्रं, पंजरः, -मंडलं the zodiac. ˚नाभिः the centre of the zodiac. --पतिः the moon. --सूचकः an astrologer.

k.v: नक्षत्रमृक्षं भं तारा तारकाप्युडु वा स्त्रियाम्. दाक्षायिण्योऽश्विनीत्यादि तारा अश्वयुगश्विनी॥
